title: docs(qa): re-point the two-factor-disable mfa_required anchor at a declaration the resolver reads
body:
Fixes #20464
Refs #20559
Clause-②: no

## What this does

`pnpm check:platform-checklist` is red on `main` with one ABSENT SYMBOL: `identity-auth.two-factor-disable-lifecycle` cites `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts#twoFactor`. Since the `mfa_required` forcing branch became a refusable patch, `twoFactor` survives in that file only as a key written INLINE in `plugins: { twoFactor: true }`, which the shared resolver deliberately does not read as a declaration.

The anchor now names `mfa_required` — the quoted settings key (`isExplicit('mfa_required')`, `key: 'mfa_required'`) that guards the same forcing branch — and the parenthetical says why it moved. This is the same repair shape as the accept-set re-points: `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs` is untouched, no citation is dropped to a bare one.

## Premise check

The behaviour the item tests did not move: `auth-plugin.ts` still forces `plugins.twoFactor` on whenever `mfa_required` is explicitly on, so the card's "if the behaviour moved, report instead" branch does not apply. The item's steps, clauses and oracle are unchanged, so `revision` is not bumped (a citation re-point is not a semantic edit, as in the accept-set precedent).

## Verification

- `symbolResolutionClass(auth-plugin.ts, 'mfa_required')` → `literal`; `'twoFactor'` → `null` (the red), measured at `ef1ed17`.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` → `OK — 15 areas, 268 items (264 active, 2 planned)`, symbol anchors `637/647 resolved … 10 on the named residual` (unchanged residual).
